clips.title: A Jaguar Walks Right By
clips.explanation: He recounts being close to a jaguar that looked at him and kept walking, illustrating how little it seemed to care.

clips.title: The Rare Jaguar Attack
clips.explanation: He says jaguar attacks are unheard of in his Amazon region, then describes an old jaguar attacking a farmer.

clips.title: Hidden in the Forest
clips.explanation: He explains how a jaguar’s spotted pattern can blend into dappled forest light, making it hard to see even nearby.

clips.title: The Jaguar’s Powerful Bite
clips.explanation: He compares jaguars with leopards and describes their build and powerful bite, including how they attack caimans.

clips.title: Jaguars on the Beach
clips.explanation: He recalls jaguars walking onto a remote beach and says the animals did not seem to care about his presence.

prompt: Find 5 clips where they talk about jaguars, the animal.
